Pokemon Hardlove Gold AI document


Brief summary:


The AI will calculate a score for every move and choose the highest scoring move to click on any given turn. If multiple moves have the same score, it randomly selects between one of them. In Double battles, the AI will calculate a score for each of its moves on each possible target, and choose the highest scoring move + target. If multiple targets have the same highest move score, the AI will randomly roll the target first, before choosing the highest move score.


The AI knows your full team’s stats, moves, and Abilities at the start of the battle. It will factor the environment (i.e. Terrain, Tailwind, Sticky Web etc) when calculating speed and damage. This includes items like Terrain Seeds activating on Switch-In.


The rest of this document will list out the possible scores for the relevant moves in the game, and the scenarios in which those scores are possible. As a general rule, the default score for non-attacking moves is +6 (tied with the highest damage attacking move). 


Lastly, the AI has a basic function to check if a move is useless. For example, if Stealth Rocks  are already set, the AI will not try to click SR again. If you are paralyzed, it will not try to paralyze you again. So on and so forth. 


Common scores to be aware of:
    Highest damaging move:                                +6 (80%), +8 (20%)
    Slow kill (AI kills but is slower than target):         +9 (80%), +11 (20%)
    Fast kill (AI kills and is faster* than target):         +12 (80%), +14 (20%)
*AI sees speed ties as them being faster than the player


















Switch AI:
The AI in this game usually does not hard switch in battle, but it is possible. There are a few Conditions in Single Battles only. In Double Battles, the AI never switches.
The AI calcs the Switch-In Score from a Post-Ko Switch-In. It factors in the highest damage it would receive on a hard switch.
The AI will not consider a switch when:
* AI has fast OHKO
* AI has slow OHKO and player does not has OHKO
* AI has at least one boosted stat
* AI has less 67% HP
* AI can deal more damage that it receives (in % on current HP)


If these conditions are not met, the AI checks if Perish Song is active. 
If Perish Song is active, the AI has a chance to switch with 


33%*( Post-Ko Score - 2)


i.e. with +4  Post-Ko Score, the AI has 66% chance to switch.
If Perish Song is not active and Post-Ko Score is +4 (or higher), the AI calculates the rate to switch according to the highest damage it would receive:


MAX(0, (50% - damageInPercent) * 3 / 5)

If the Post-Ko Score is +5 or higher it adds a flat 5% to the rate above.
If the AI has a fast pivot move it can use, it will use the pivot move instead of hard switching.


The PostKO Switch-in function will ignore mons that are faster but being oneshot, or slower and being 2Shot. It will further heavily penalize Base-Mega forms (that can mega).
















Diverting targets in Doubles:
  

The AI will calculate the faster mon first. If it sees a fast OHKO, the partner mon will completely ignore the player’s mon that will be a fast OHKO.
